lines.zh: 我用尾扇推开温水，海底的沙慢慢后移。
lines.en: My tail fan pushes the warm water back; the seabed sand drifts away.

lines.zh: 刺在背上轻轻磕响，像一串小石子。
lines.en: The spikes on my back click softly, like a string of small pebbles.

lines.zh: 我横着挪过海草，钳子举得比头还高。
lines.en: I sidle past the seagrass with my claws raised above my head.

lines.zh: 深温水海洋的底上，我走得不快。
lines.en: On the deep lukewarm seabed I do not walk quickly.

lines.zh: 我们四只踩着同一条沙沟往前走。
lines.en: The four of us tread forward along the same sandy trench.

lines.zh: 腿节敲在礁石上，发出闷闷的响声。
lines.en: My leg joints knock against the reef with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 水流往北，我偏要往南挪一格。
lines.en: The current runs north; I insist on shifting one block south.

lines.zh: 壳太重，每一步都把沙压出浅坑。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; every step presses a shallow pit into the sand.

lines.zh: 明知前面有海沟，我还是先摸过去。
lines.en: I know a trench lies ahead, yet I feel my way toward it.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过的地方，沙子留下一道短痕。
lines.en: Where my tail sweeps, the sand keeps a short scar.

lines.zh: 白天海底也暗，我靠触须找路。
lines.en: The seabed is dark even by day, so I find my way by antennae.

lines.zh: 钳子替我拨开挡路的海带。
lines.en: My claws push the kelp out of my way.

lines.zh: 我把自己卡在两块礁石中间取暖。
lines.en: I wedge myself between two rocks to keep warm.

lines.zh: 温水的浮力托着我，我懒得下沉。
lines.en: The warm water holds me up, and I cannot be bothered to sink.

lines.zh: 有只海龟从头顶游过，我不打算追。
lines.en: A turtle swims overhead; I have no plan to chase it.

lines.zh: 我数着鳃室里进出的水，一下又一下。
lines.en: I count the water passing through my gills, one pulse after another.

lines.zh: 刺上挂了一小段海草，我没去理它。
lines.en: A scrap of seagrass snags on my spikes; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 深水很静，只有我的壳偶尔咔一声。
lines.en: The deep is quiet, except for my shell clicking now and then.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只钳子，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I raise one claw slowly, then lower it again.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着半块贝壳，我用须碰了碰。
lines.en: Half a shell lies buried in the sand; I touch it with an antenna.

lines.zh: 我面朝上，看光线在水面碎成几片。
lines.en: Facing upward, I watch the light break into pieces at the surface.

lines.zh: 温水让我发困，触须垂了下来。
lines.en: The warm water makes me drowsy, and my antennae droop.

lines.zh: 我在等水流变凉，等得很有耐心。
lines.en: I am waiting for the current to cool, and I am patient.

lines.zh: 身后那片珊瑚不错，我不打算让开。
lines.en: The coral behind me is good ground; I do not intend to move.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，像在数自己的呼吸。
lines.en: My gills open and close as if counting my own breaths.

lines.zh: 龙虾刺长得很密，把背撑得满满的。
lines.en: My lobster spikes grow densely, filling my whole back.

lines.zh: 你潜到这么深，带的气够回去吗。
lines.en: You dove this deep; is your air enough to get back?

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼搅起沙，全落在我身上。
lines.en: Your fins stir up sand, and all of it settles on me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，钳子停在半空。
lines.en: I look up at you with my claws frozen mid-air.

lines.zh: 你身上有船上带下来的铁味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of iron from your boat.

lines.zh: 隔着一层水看，你的脸有点变形。
lines.en: Seen through the water, your face looks a little warped.

lines.zh: 我认得你腰上那串备用氧气泡。
lines.en: I recognize those spare air bubbles at your waist.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩在礁石上，我听得很清。
lines.en: I hear your boots clearly as they land on the reef.

lines.zh: 你在打量我的刺，我在打量你的手指。
lines.en: You study my spikes; I study your fingers.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进来，温水里界线看不清。
lines.en: Do not reach in; boundaries blur in warm water.

lines.zh: 我歪一下壳，让水从刺缝里流走。
lines.en: I tilt my shell to let the water drain between my spikes.

lines.zh: 你退半步的动作，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see that half step you took backward very clearly.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，比鱼群更让我在意。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over me, and it matters more than any school of fish.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了一道，声音很脆。
lines.en: My shell cracks open, and the sound is brittle.

lines.zh: 疼，但我还没打算让开。
lines.en: It hurts, but I am not moving aside yet.

lines.zh: 你把我的刺磕断了两根。
lines.en: You snapped two of my spikes.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，只留钳子在外。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and leave only my claws out.

lines.zh: 这一下打得不轻，沙都被掀起来。
lines.en: That hit was heavy; even the sand is thrown up.

lines.zh: 我的血混进温水里，很快就淡了。
lines.en: My blood mixes into the warm water and fades fast.

lines.zh: 别以为我退就是怕。
lines.en: Do not think my retreat means fear.

lines.zh: 壳下面比看上去软，你运气好。
lines.en: I am softer under the shell than I look; lucky you.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，一瘸一拐地撑着。
lines.en: I walk crooked, limping along.

lines.zh: 这伤我记着，海底不缺时间。
lines.en: I will remember this wound; the seabed has time.

lines.zh: 你把鱼饵举在面前，我只闻到铁腥。
lines.en: You hold bait before me; all I smell is iron.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手里的东西，我自己会找。
lines.en: I will not eat from your hand; I find my own food.

lines.zh: 诱饵沉下来，落在我的刺上滑走了。
lines.en: The bait sinks, lands on my spikes, and slides off.

lines.zh: 想用一块鱼肉换我的钳子？不行。
lines.en: Trade one piece of fish for my claw? No.

lines.zh: 我连生龙虾都吃腻了，别说你的面包。
lines.en: I am tired even of raw lobster, let alone your bread.

lines.zh: 那片鱼饵晃得我眼晕，我选择后退。
lines.en: That dangling bait makes me dizzy, so I choose to back away.

lines.zh: 我绕过鱼钩，从另一边爬过去。
lines.en: I go around the hook and crawl past on the other side.

lines.zh: 你的手抖了一下，水纹先到了我这里。
lines.en: Your hand trembles, and the ripples reach me first.

lines.zh: 食物放地上吧，我只会踩过它。
lines.en: Leave the food on the ground; I will only walk over it.

lines.zh: 我朝诱饵吐了个泡，然后转身。
lines.en: I blow a bubble at the bait, then turn away.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的刺，护甲会先叫一声。
lines.en: You hit my spikes, and your armor will complain first.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，你的膝盖会记住。
lines.en: My shell is hard, and your knee will remember it.

lines.zh: 别推我，我会把整排刺立起来。
lines.en: Do not push me, or I will raise the whole row of spikes.

lines.zh: 你从我背上跨过去，腿被扎了一下。
lines.en: You stepped over my back and got pricked in the leg.

lines.zh: 我横着挡路，这是海底本来的规矩。
lines.en: I block the way sideways; that is how the seabed works.

lines.zh: 你的船底刮到我，木屑掉进沙里。
lines.en: Your hull scrapes me, and wood shavings drop into the sand.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过，刺擦出细小的声音。
lines.en: I glide past you, my spikes making a thin scraping sound.

lines.zh: 你退让的那一步，正好踩进我的沙坑。
lines.en: The step you gave up landed right in my sand pit.

lines.zh: 硬碰硬没好处，我的壳比你的盾厚。
lines.en: Ramming me gains nothing; my shell is thicker than your shield.

lines.zh: 我的尾扇扫到你，水花炸开一圈。
lines.en: My tail fan catches you and throws a ring of spray.

lines.zh: 我敲壳三下，这是龙虾求偶的意思。
lines.en: I tap my shell three times; that is how lobsters court.

lines.zh: 她回敲两下，我就知道成了。
lines.en: She taps back twice, and I know it is settled.

lines.zh: 我们用触须互相碰，像在核对暗号。
lines.en: We touch antennae, as if checking a secret signal.

lines.zh: 沙沟里挖出的浅坑，是给卵准备的。
lines.en: The shallow pit dug in the trench is meant for eggs.

lines.zh: 我把最直的刺给她看，这算体面。
lines.en: I show her my straightest spike; that counts as dignity.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，谁都不肯先转身。
lines.en: We walk side by side, and neither will turn first.

lines.zh: 温水季节到了，海底到处是敲壳声。
lines.en: The warm season is here, and shell tapping fills the seabed.

lines.zh: 她比我宽出一截，我照样敲壳。
lines.en: She is a full size wider, and I tap my shell anyway.

lines.zh: 交配后我们分开，各守一方礁石。
lines.en: Afterward we part, each guarding a stretch of reef.

lines.zh: 卵粘在腹下，我走路都放轻了。
lines.en: The eggs cling beneath me, so I walk more gently.

lines.zh: 这块生龙虾掉在沙上，我夹起来。
lines.en: This raw lobster fell on the sand, so I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我捡了块碎贝壳，没什么用，但好看。
lines.en: I pick up a broken shell: useless, but pretty.

lines.zh: 脱落的龙虾刺，我拨到窝边上。
lines.en: A shed lobster spike gets nudged to the edge of my den.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到刺缝里，我抖了抖壳。
lines.en: Something rolls between my spikes, so I shake my shell.

lines.zh: 我把食物塞到颚边，慢慢磨。
lines.en: I stuff the food by my mandibles and grind it slowly.

lines.zh: 我从不空手，钳子上总挂着点什么。
lines.en: My claws are never empty; something always hangs from them.

lines.zh: 这块肉是别人掉的，现在归我了。
lines.en: Someone dropped this meat; it belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我拖着比自己还大的东西走，很难看。
lines.en: I drag something larger than myself, and it looks ridiculous.

lines.zh: 捡起来又掉下去，我试了第三次。
lines.en: It drops again after I lift it; I try a third time.

lines.zh: 沙里那点闪光，我先按住了再说。
lines.en: That glimmer in the sand; I pin it down first and ask later.

lines.zh: 你身上有血味，水把它带到我这里。
lines.en: You smell of blood, and the water carries it to me.

lines.zh: 我立起刺，把钳子摆到前面。
lines.en: I raise my spikes and bring my claws forward.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游得慢，我先记下它。
lines.en: That fish swims slowly; I make a note of it.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了礁石上的贝壳，我听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a shell on the reef, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 深水里有东西在动，我朝那边转。
lines.en: Something moves in the deep, and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我不主动追，但进了范围的别想走。
lines.en: I do not chase, but nothing in range walks away.

lines.zh: 你腰上的鱼竿让我很不舒服。
lines.en: The fishing rod at your waist bothers me.

lines.zh: 目标定了，我的腿开始一下下蓄力。
lines.en: The target is set, and my legs begin to gather strength.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的脚踝，那里最容易夹。
lines.en: I fix on your ankle; it is the easiest place to clamp.

lines.zh: 温水的流动告诉我，你正在靠近。
lines.en: The warm current tells me you are getting closer.

lines.zh: 我们四只一起转向，你最好退开。
lines.en: All four of us turn at once; you had better back off.

lines.zh: 我把刺全张开，这是最后一次警告。
lines.en: I spread every spike; this is the last warning.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶晃了一下，我改了主意。
lines.en: The bucket in your hand sways, and I change my mind.

lines.zh: 谁先动，谁就先被夹住。
lines.en: Whoever moves first gets clamped first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢横移，把你的退路堵在礁石边。
lines.en: I edge sideways and pin your retreat against the reef.

lines.zh: 钳子张开又合上，水被挤出一小声。
lines.en: My claws open and shut, squeezing a small sound from the water.

lines.zh: 我离你三格，正好一步突进。
lines.en: I am three blocks away, exactly one lunge from you.

lines.zh: 你往上游，我就贴在下面跟着。
lines.en: You swim up; I follow pressed beneath you.

lines.zh: 我的触须一直在碰你的影子。
lines.en: My antennae keep brushing against your shadow.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会看见我举着钳子。
lines.en: Do not look back; you would see my claws raised.

lines.zh: 我在数你的呼吸，等你换气。
lines.en: I count your breaths, waiting for you to surface.

lines.zh: 沙被我踩出细线，一直连到你脚下。
lines.en: My steps draw a thin line in the sand, straight to your feet.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡得住剑，挡不住两只钳子。
lines.en: Your shield stops swords, not two claws.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，海底的暗处是我的。
lines.en: I circle to your flank; the dark of the seabed is mine.

lines.zh: 刺竖起时，水声会先替我说话。
lines.en: When my spikes rise, the water speaks for me first.

lines.zh: 我停住不动，这比追更让你难受。
lines.en: I hold still, and that unsettles you more than chasing.

lines.zh: 你的氧气在减少，我很有耐心。
lines.en: Your air is running low, and I have plenty of patience.

lines.zh: 我突然快了一点，你的手也快了一点。
lines.en: I speed up slightly, and your hand moves a little faster.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，把你的圈子收小。
lines.en: I step sideways and close your circle a little.

lines.zh: 钳子合上，你的护甲凹下去一块。
lines.en: My claw closes and dents your armor.

lines.zh: 刺先到，钳子后到，你小腿一麻。
lines.en: The spikes arrive first, then the claw; your calf goes numb.

lines.zh: 你被撞退两格，水里的血散成雾。
lines.en: You are knocked back two blocks as blood blooms in the water.

lines.zh: 我用尾扇拍你，把你按进沙里。
lines.en: I slap you with my tail fan and press you into the sand.

lines.zh: 这一夹是温水海底教我的。
lines.en: The warm seabed taught me this clamp.

lines.zh: 你跌坐在礁石上，我补了第二下。
lines.en: You drop onto the reef, and I land a second blow.

lines.zh: 我的刺划开你的袖子，仅此而已。
lines.en: My spikes tear your sleeve, nothing more.

lines.zh: 你流血了，味道会引来更多龙虾。
lines.en: You bleed, and that smell will draw more lobsters.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，我的钳子比你的手快。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; my claw is faster.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的靴子，把你拖了半步。
lines.en: I bite your boot and drag you half a step.

lines.zh: 打中了，我自己的壳也震得发麻。
lines.en: It lands, and the shock numbs my own shell.

lines.zh: 你退得太急，后背撞在珊瑚上。
lines.en: You retreat too fast and your back hits the coral.

lines.zh: 这一下没夹实，我会再来一次。
lines.en: That clamp did not hold; I will try again.

lines.zh: 海底的沙被我们搅成一片白。
lines.en: Between us we churn the seabed into white silt.

lines.zh: 我从温水海洋的暗处爬出来，先露刺。
lines.en: I crawl out of the lukewarm dark, spikes first.

lines.zh: 这一片海底归我们四只，你算第五个。
lines.en: This patch of seabed belongs to four of us; you are the fifth.

lines.zh: 水比昨天暖，所以我才在这里。
lines.en: The water is warmer than yesterday, which is why I am here.

lines.zh: 我踩上第一块礁石，就把钳子举起。
lines.en: I step onto the first rock and raise my claws.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开的时候，我听见了海流。
lines.en: When the spawn egg cracked, I heard the current.

lines.zh: 深水里没有太阳，我照样认得方向。
lines.en: There is no sun in the deep, yet I know my way.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出，背上还挂着沙。
lines.en: I push out of the sand still wearing a layer of it.

lines.zh: 这片海沟很空，正好放下我的窝。
lines.en: This trench is empty, perfect for my den.

lines.zh: 我生来就带着整背的刺。
lines.en: I was born with a back full of spikes.

lines.zh: 温水深处从今天起多一只龙虾。
lines.en: From today the warm deep holds one more lobster.

lines.zh: 我一落地就开始横着走。
lines.en: The moment I land, I start walking sideways.

lines.zh: 头顶的水面很远，我无所谓。
lines.en: The surface is far above me, and I do not care.

lines.zh: 沙里那些贝壳，从现在起归我了。
lines.en: Those shells in the sand belong to me from now on.

lines.zh: 我出来得安静，但壳一响你就知道。
lines.en: I emerge quietly, but one click of my shell gives me away.

lines.zh: 四只一起，从温水的裂缝里出来。
lines.en: Four of us come out of a crack in the warm water.

lines.zh: 我一落地，刺就全竖起来了。
lines.en: The moment I land, every spine stands up.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我整壳发红，我往深处沉。
lines.en: The scalding water reddens my shell, so I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上摔下来，刺先着地断了两根。
lines.en: I fall from the reef and land spikes first, snapping two.

lines.zh: 我鳃里全是水，真讽刺，我居然会呛。
lines.en: My gills are full of water; ironic that I can choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，壳上留下一片焦黑。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and leaves a scorched patch on my shell.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我刺缝里，晃得我难受。
lines.en: An arrow wedges between my spikes and rattles painfully.

lines.zh: 魔法从我壳缝钻进去，凉得像冰水。
lines.en: Magic seeps through my shell seams, cold as ice water.

lines.zh: 我饿到钳子发抖，还是不吃那诱饵。
lines.en: Hunger makes my claws tremble, and still I refuse the bait.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海里，我的壳麻了一整夜。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea, and my shell stays numb all night.

lines.zh: 海底下面没有底，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: There is no floor beneath the seabed, and I keep falling.
